description: This file defines the `TestDataService` class used for managing test fixture data in the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods for populating, truncating, and querying fixture data into a database, primarily for testing purposes. The class interacts with Doctrine ORM and YAML files to load and insert data, supporting operations such as populating fixtures, fetching recent records, and converting fixture data into entities.

classes.name: TestDataService
classes.description: Utility class for managing test fixture data, including loading fixtures, populating database tables, and fetching inserted records. Provides methods to handle fixture files, generate SQL queries, and convert fixture data into entity objects.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Load fixture data from a given YAML file path and populate the database tables accordingly.

methods.name: _populateUsingPdoTransaction
methods.description: Internal method to populate data using PDO transactions, with caching support.

methods.name: _generatePdoInsertQueryArray
methods.description: Generate SQL insert queries for a given table and data.

methods.name: _generateMultipleInsertQueryArray
methods.description: Create multiple insert SQL queries for the provided table data.

methods.name: _generateInsetQueryColumnString
methods.description: Construct the column part of an SQL insert statement based on data attributes.

methods.name: _getTableName
methods.description: Retrieve the database table name corresponding to a table alias.

methods.name: _getClassMetadata
methods.description: Get Doctrine ClassMetadata for a given entity alias.

methods.name: _setData
methods.description: Load and parse fixture YAML data from file and set internal data structures.

methods.name: _encryptFieldsInFixture
methods.description: Encrypt specific fixture fields if encryption is configured.

methods.name: getFQEntityName
methods.description: Get fully qualified entity class name based on alias or class existence.

methods.name: _setTableNames
methods.description: Set internal table names array based on fixture data.

methods.name: _disableConstraints
methods.description: Disable foreign key constraints on the database connection.

methods.name: _enableConstraints
methods.description: Re-enable foreign key constraints.

methods.name: _truncateTables
methods.description: Truncate database tables, optionally based on provided table names.

methods.name: _getDbConnection
methods.description: Get the PDO database connection object.

methods.name: truncateTables
methods.description: Public method to truncate tables based on aliases.

methods.name: truncateSpecificTables
methods.description: Truncate specific tables by alias array.

methods.name: fetchLastInsertedRecords
methods.description: Retrieve the last inserted records for a given entity alias.

methods.name: fetchLastInsertedRecord
methods.description: Retrieve the most recent inserted record for a given entity alias, ordered by a specified column.

methods.name: fetchObject
methods.description: Fetch a specific entity object by primary key.

methods.name: parseFixtureFile
methods.description: Parse and cache a fixture YAML file.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Load specific fixture data by key from a fixture file.

methods.name: loadObjectList
methods.description: Load list of entities from fixture data.

methods.name: loadObjectListFromArray
methods.description: Convert fixture data array into entity objects.

methods.name: getFieldForColumn
methods.description: Get entity field name for a given database column.

methods.name: getTypeForField
methods.description: Get data type for a specified entity field.

methods.name: getAssociationMapping
methods.description: Retrieve association mapping for an entity field, if exists.
